citation: Gersten, R., Dimino, J., Jayanthi, M., Kim, J. S., & Santoro, L. E. (2010). Teacher Study Group: Impact of the professional development model on reading instruction and student outcomes in first grade classrooms. American Educational Research Journal, 47(3), 694-739. https://doi.org/10.3102/0002831209361208
url: https://dash.harvard.edu/handle/1/28983235 (Harvard DASH green OA, CC-BY submitted manuscript; PDF bitstream https://dash.harvard.edu/server/api/core/bitstreams/7312037e-0506-6bd4-e053-0100007fdf3b/content)
design: Cluster RCT; assignment level = School (matched-pair random assignment within district); 19 Reading First schools across 3 urban districts (CA n=10, PA n=6, VA n=3); 81 first-grade teachers; 468 students analytic sample (217 TSG, 251 control); subject = reading (comprehension & vocabulary); grade = first grade (K-2 band). Intervention = Teacher Study Group (TSG) collaborative PD model vs business-as-usual (control schools received only the district's mandated Reading First PD, no TSG).
problems: School-by-condition split not separately reported (matched-pair assignment within districts implies ~9-10 schools per condition; n_clusters=19 total recorded). Effect sizes are the standardized HLM treatment coefficients (gamma02) from Table 7; the paper labels these directly as 'effect size (ES)' because all outcome measures were standardized to mean 0, SD 1 before modeling, so the coefficient IS the standardized mean difference d and its reported se is the impact SE. ICC for student outcomes = 0.22 (post-hoc actual value from Table 5; a-priori design value was 0.05). g computed as J*d using df = n_t+n_c-2 per project convention (matches borman_2007/bleses_2021 handling). The study examines a K-2 band per the registry but is specifically grade 1.

effect_sizes.arm_label: Teacher Study Group (TSG) PD vs business-as-usual control
effect_sizes.g_method: Outcome standardized to mean 0/SD 1; Table 7 TSG treatment coefficient gamma02 = d = 0.44, se(d) = 0.25 from a two-level (student/school) HLM with school-mean Letter Naming Fluency pretest covariate (cluster-randomized RCT). g = J*d, J = 1 - 3/(4*df-1) with df = n_t+n_c-2 = 466, J = 0.99839; g = 0.43929; g_se = J*se(d) = 0.24960; g_var = g_se^2 = 0.062299. Standardized via the within-sample SD of the standardized outcome metric used in the model.
effect_sizes.notes: One of three confirmatory TARGET measures directly aligned with the TSG focus (vocabulary/comprehension). Headline finding: 'moderately large effect size for Oral Vocabulary, ES = .44, was marginally significant' (t ratio 1.73, p<.10).
